info.title: IntentLock API
info.summary: AI-commerce authorization firewall: wallets, sessions, payments and proof.
info.description:
IntentLock sits between an AI shopping agent and the money. A user grants a bounded Intent Wallet; every agent-proposed purchase is evaluated by deterministic policy (ALLOW, STEP_UP or BLOCK) before any checkout. This contract covers the sandbox demo and API-client surface only.

SAFETY: the hosted demo is PayPal Sandbox only. Money moves only through PayPal checkout approved by the buyer plus a verified PayPal webhook; no endpoint here moves funds directly.

AUTH: call POST /api/access/demo for a 30-minute bearer token, or use an API client key. Demo POST mutations require a unique x-intentlock-request-id header (16-128 chars of [-a-zA-Z0-9_]) to prevent replay.

Operator-only routes (x-intentlock-ops-token) are out of scope and not documented.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: PayPal checkout, authorize, capture and proof

get.summary: Payment provider mode and PayPal readiness
Evaluate provider capability for a hypothetical payment

post.summary: Issue a sandbox demo capability token
post.description: Sandbox only (requires demo access enabled and PayPal sandbox). No request body or credentials. Token expires after 30 minutes. Rate limited per IP and globally (429 DEMO_ISSUANCE_LIMIT). Returns 503 SANDBOX_ACCESS_DISABLED when demo access is off.

post.summary: Rotate a demo capability for a fresh 30-minute token
post.description: Demo capability required (403 DEMO_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED otherwise). The old token stops working; reuse returns 401 CAPABILITY_ALREADY_ROTATED.

get.summary: List wallets visible to the caller (max 50)

post.description: Demo callers: currency must be USD, totalAuthority and maxSingleTransaction <= 100, validUntil within 24 hours (else 403 DEMO_AUTHORITY_LIMIT); per-principal and per-IP hourly limits (429 DEMO_WALLET_LIMIT). Requires x-intentlock-request-id for demo callers.

400.description: Validation failure. error is WALLET_REQUEST_FAILED (with message from schema validation), INVALID_WALLET_LIMITS, INVALID_CURRENCY_CODE, INVALID_COUNTRY_CODE, INVALID_AUTHORITY_HIERARCHY, INVALID_EXPIRY, REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED or INVALID_JSON.

post.summary: Evaluate a hypothetical transaction against a wallet
post.description: Records a decision and, for STEP_UP, issues a step-up request. Does not move money.
Idempotent: alreadyRevoked is true if it was revoked earlier. The body is optional.

get.summary: List sessions visible to the caller

post.summary: Create a purchase session for a wallet
post.description: Demo callers: connectorId must be paypal-demo-marketplace and channel WEB. Discovery-only connectors (shopify-global-catalog, channel3-catalog) cannot create sessions.

example.prompt: Buy wireless ANC headphones from Sony or Bose under $75

400.description: WALLET_ID_REQUIRED, PROMPT_REQUIRED, INVALID_CHANNEL, CONNECTOR_NOT_AVAILABLE (with connectorId), REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED, SESSION_REQUEST_FAILED.

409.description: REQUEST_REPLAYED, or WALLET_NOT_READY (revoked, expired, no authority, or less than 15 minutes of validity left) with code, message and readiness.

example.message: This Intent Wallet has less than 15 minutes remaining, so a new payment cannot be safely started.

get.summary: Get a session and its event log

post.summary: Run the shopping agent and evaluate every candidate against wallet policy
post.description: Only runs on sessions in CREATED status. Send agentMode "compromised" to simulate a prompt-injected agent; the firewall then overrules it (see agent.overruled). The body is optional (defaults to live). Failures (for example session not runnable) return 400 SESSION_REQUEST_FAILED with a code from the closed vocabulary (often PAYMENT_OPERATION_FAILED).

400.description: INVALID_AGENT_MODE, REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED, or SESSION_REQUEST_FAILED with code and message.

post.summary: Create the PayPal checkout order for an approved session
post.description: Idempotent. Money never moves here: the buyer must approve the order at PayPal checkout.

409.description: SESSION_PAYMENT_FAILED with a PaymentErrorCode, or REQUEST_REPLAYED.

get.summary: Get the payment record and wallet reservation for a session

post.description: Requires the buyer to have approved the order at PayPal checkout.

409.description: PAYPAL_AUTHORIZE_FAILED with a PaymentErrorCode, or REQUEST_REPLAYED.

post.description: Final settlement is confirmed by the verified PayPal webhook.

409.description: PAYPAL_CAPTURE_FAILED with a PaymentErrorCode, or REQUEST_REPLAYED.

List commerce connectors and whether each is enabled

connectors.name: Channel3 Product Catalog
connectors.description: Real product discovery only. Disabled until CHANNEL3_ENABLED and the CHANNEL3_API_KEY secret are set; no checkout.

post.summary: Search a connector and evaluate each candidate against a wallet
post.description: Discovery and policy are separated: wallet rules are never sent to the marketplace. Discovery-only connectors (shopify-global-catalog, channel3-catalog) return discoveryOnly:true and executionAllowed:false; their candidates can never auto-execute and cannot be turned into sessions or payments. For demo callers, channel3-catalog is accepted only when enabled server-side and is rate limited (429 CHANNEL3_RATE_LIMITED); otherwise 403 DEMO_CONNECTOR_ONLY. channel3-catalog accepts only walletId, connectorId, query (<=400 chars) and limit, else 400 CHANNEL3_ARGUMENTS_INVALID.

400.description: WALLET_ID_REQUIRED, SEARCH_QUERY_REQUIRED, CONNECTOR_NOT_AVAILABLE, CHANNEL3_ARGUMENTS_INVALID, MCP_ARGUMENTS_INVALID, MCP_TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED, COMMERCE_SEARCH_FAILED (with message), REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED.

post.summary: Evaluate a refund against policy (no provider call)
post.description: Read-only policy check; reports ALLOW or BLOCK with violations. Requesting or syncing a refund is operator-only and is not part of this contract.

400.description: TRUST_CENTER_OPERATION_FAILED with message (for example SESSION_PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_REFUND_REASON), or REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED.

post.description: Requires an API client key with the authorize scope, sent as a Bearer token. Idempotent per idempotencyKey. An ALLOW decision returns a signed token.

400.description: INVALID_JSON, or AUTHORIZATION_FAILED with message MISSING_* / INVALID_*.

post.description: Requires an API client key with the verify scope.

401.description: valid:false with a reason, or MISSING_API_KEY / INVALID_API_KEY.

bearerAuth.description: Demo capability token (ildemo_...) from POST /api/access/demo, or an API client key. The x-intentlock-key header is accepted as an alternative to Authorization on /api routes.

opsToken.name: x-intentlock-ops-token
opsToken.description: Operator token. Operator-only routes are out of scope for this contract; the scheme is declared for completeness.

RequestId.name: x-intentlock-request-id
RequestId.description: Required (400 REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED if missing or malformed) on every demo-capability POST mutation except /api/access/*. Must be unique per request (409 REQUEST_REPLAYED on reuse). Use a UUID.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input. Body is {error} (for example REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED, RESOURCE_ID_REQUIRED, INVALID_JSON, WALLET_ID_REQUIRED) or a route-specific envelope.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired credentials: AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, UNAUTHORIZED, INVALID_CAPABILITY, INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_CAPABILITY, INVALID_API_KEY, CAPABILITY_ALREADY_ROTATED.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE, DEMO_CONNECTOR_ONLY, DEMO_CHANNEL_ONLY, DEMO_AUTHORITY_LIMIT, OPERATOR_REQUIRED, SANDBOX_ACCESS_DISABLED, DEMO_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED.

NotFound.description: RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: the resource does not exist OR the caller has no permission on it. Existence is deliberately not revealed.

Replayed.description: REQUEST_REPLAYED: the x-intentlock-request-id nonce was already used by this principal. Send a fresh value.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED, DEMO_ISSUANCE_LIMIT, DEMO_WALLET_LIMIT, DEMO_MUTATION_LIMIT, DEMO_AI_LIMIT, CHANNEL3_RATE_LIMITED or SHOPIFY_CATALOG_RATE_LIMITED.

Unavailable.description: ACCESS_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE (database not configured or gate failure) or SANDBOX_ACCESS_DISABLED.

PaymentFailure.description: Payment precondition or provider failure. error is the operation (SESSION_PAYMENT_FAILED, PAYPAL_AUTHORIZE_FAILED, PAYPAL_CAPTURE_FAILED); code is a PaymentErrorCode.

error.description: Machine-readable error code. Access-gate errors (401/403/404/409/413/429/503) carry only this field.

code.description: Closed-vocabulary diagnostic code (see PaymentErrorCode) on session/payment failures.

message.description: Human-readable detail. For payment failures this equals code.

providerStatus.description: HTTP status returned by PayPal when code is PAYPAL_REQUEST_REJECTED or PAYPAL_OAUTH_REJECTED.

Error.description: Common error envelope. Some routes add extra fields (for example readiness, sessionStatus, connectorId, required).

AccessErrorCode.description: Values of Error.error produced by the access gate.

PaymentErrorCode.description: Closed vocabulary returned in Error.code by session and payment failures. Unrecognised internal errors collapse to PAYMENT_OPERATION_FAILED; runtime detail after a colon is dropped.

token.description: Demo capability bearer token (ildemo_ followed by 64 hex characters). Shown once; keep it out of logs.

autoBuyLimit.description: Purchases up to this amount may auto-execute.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code from the supported list. Defaults to INR when omitted; demo callers must send USD.

validUntil.description: Must be in the future. Demo limit: at most 24 hours from now.

decisionId.description: Identifier of the recorded decision (type is driver-defined).

stepUp.description: Step-up request details when decision is STEP_UP, otherwise null.

reason.description: Optional; control characters are stripped and the value is truncated to 200 characters.

merchantMessage.description: UNTRUSTED merchant-supplied text. Never treated as instructions.

CommerceProduct.description: Normalised product. Additional internal fields (source, authorizationContext, discovery) may be present.

query.description: Product intent, at most 400 characters for discovery-only connectors.

connectorId.description: Defaults to demo-marketplace. Demo callers: paypal-demo-marketplace, or channel3-catalog when enabled server-side.

CommerceSearchRequest.description: channel3-catalog accepts only walletId, connectorId, query and limit; any other key yields 400 CHANNEL3_ARGUMENTS_INVALID.

searchQuery.description: Planned query actually sent to the connector. Wallet rules are never sent as filters.

connectorId.description: Defaults to demo-marketplace. Demo callers must use paypal-demo-marketplace. Discovery-only connectors are rejected with 403 COMMERCE_DISCOVERY_ONLY.

channel.description: Case-insensitive. Demo callers may only use WEB.

Session.description: Purchase session. Legacy Razorpay fields and idempotency internals may also be present.

agentMode.description: live asks the sandbox AI agent for a recommendation; compromised simulates an agent that obeys merchant prompt-injection text. Either way the deterministic wallet policy decides.

overruled.description: True when the firewall rejected or changed the agent proposal.

AgentOutcome.description: What the (untrusted) shopping agent proposed and whether IntentLock overruled it.

Reservation.description: Wallet authority reservation row (snake_case column names as returned).

duplicate.description: True when a checkout order already existed for the session.

reservation.description: Reservation row or null/absent when none.

authorization.description: Provider authorization details. Absent when duplicate is true.

capture.description: Public capture details. Absent on some duplicate responses.

verified.description: True only when integrity checks pass and (for PayPal) the recipient is verified.

currency.description: Defaults to the captured payment currency.

PostPurchaseState.description: Read-only post-purchase snapshot. Exact inner shapes are not pinned by this contract.

quoteHash.description: Optional; must match the server-computed hash or 409 QUOTE_HASH_MISMATCH is returned.

token.description: Signed INTENTLOCK_AUTH_V1 token. Issued only for ALLOW.

reason.description: Present when valid is false (for example MALFORMED_TOKEN, INVALID_SIGNATURE, CLIENT_MISMATCH, AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND, TOKEN_HASH_MISMATCH, WALLET_ACCESS_REVOKED).
